#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int N = 250005;
int n, k, mod, lg, m;
vector<int> fac(N), ifac(N), inv(N), cnt(N), v(N);
vector<vector<int>> f(N, vector<int>(18, 0));
vector<int> c(18), ans(18);

inline void add(vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int fg) {
    for (int i = 0; i < lg; ++i) {
        a[i] += fg ? b[i] : (mod - b[i]);
        if (a[i] >= mod) a[i] -= mod;
    }
}

inline void mul(vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    fill(c.begin(), c.end(), 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < lg; ++i) {
        if (!a[i]) continue;
        for (int j = 0; i + j < lg; ++j)
            c[i + j] = (1LL * a[i] * b[j] + c[i + j]) % mod;
    }
    copy(c.begin(), c.end(), a.begin());
}

inline void fpm(vector<int>& a, int b) {
    fill(ans.begin(), ans.end(), 0);
    ans[0] = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) mul(ans, a);
        if (b >>= 1) mul(a, a);
    }
    copy(ans.begin(), ans.end(), a.begin());
}

inline int qpow(int a, int b) {
    int res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = 1LL * res * a % mod;
        if (b >>= 1) a = 1LL * a * a % mod;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cin >> n >> k >> mod;
    if (n & 1) {
        cout << qpow(k, n);
        return 0;
    }
    fac[0] = ifac[0] = f[0][0] = 1;
    m = 1; lg = 0;
    while (m <= n) { m <<= 1; ++lg; }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        inv[i] = (i == 1) ? 1 : 1LL * (mod - mod / i) * inv[mod % i] % mod;
        fac[i] = 1LL * fac[i - 1] * i % mod;
        ifac[i] = 1LL * ifac[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
        cnt[i] = __builtin_popcount(i);
        f[i][cnt[i]] = ifac[i];
    }
    v[n] = 1;
    for (int i = n; i; --i) {
        if (!v[i]) continue;
        for (int j = i; j; j = (j - 1) & i)
            v[j] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j)
            if (j & i) add(f[j], f[j ^ i], 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i)
        if (v[i]) fpm(f[i], k);
    for (int i = 1; i < m; i <<= 1)
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j)
            if (j & i) add(f[j], f[j ^ i], 0);
    int ans = (qpow(k, n) - 1LL * f[n][cnt[n]] * fac[n] % mod + mod) % mod;
    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}
